readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Five bridges: authentic/attributed finding, biological direction, current state versus dependence, clinical fit, separate eligibility/access.
Core plus two optional shelves is a conceptual reading map, not a validated protocol. Minutes and route repetition earn no teaching credit.
The later-only four-case shelf teaches rescue of supply, localisation of the active pathway step, stress-defence direction and energy-versus-damage measurements.
Keep DNA -> RNA -> protein -> measured repair/function -> model response -> clinical outcome in a ledger of separate observations and gaps; mechanism is not utility.
Preserve original/later index differences after complete diff reconciliation. Personal-context route section is excluded from public content and credit.
Selective trapped-PARP removal remains preclinical; broad lysosomal agents, model mixtures and exposures cannot inherit the mechanism or clinical benefit.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Finding sentence requires specimen, assay, exact change/location, reference-genome version, transcript and supporting reads. Predicted splice consequences and measured RNA junctions differ.
Local usable depth and intended-territory breadth differ; high average coverage does not rescue an unmeasured locus or unsuitable alteration-class test.

Identity/preparation/alignment errors, repeated report templates and genuinely orthogonal confirmation have different independence. Reconcile adequate contradictory assays; inadequate negative is uninformative.
Adequate appropriate matched normal helps origin but tumour-only cannot always attribute; VUS is not pathogenic by gene-name familiarity.
Origin, malignant/nonmalignant mixture, clonality, VAF/CCF, purity, local copies and altered-copy multiplicity differ. Authenticity is not driver status or survival dependence.
Fictional 32/160=20%; with 50% purity, diploid region and one altered copy per affected cancer cell, expected VAF=p*CCF/2 yields CCF80%; pure cancer gives40%. Not a real-sample estimate.
Technical confirmation still leaves RNA/protein/function and clinical actionability; practice negative-without-coverage answer retains exact site, limits, specimen/time and targeted confirmation.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: HR team and matching-template repair versus alternative joining; HRD is impaired process rather than gene/variant name.

Alleles are sequence versions, physical copy count can change; biallelic useful-function loss needs same malignant population, allele-specific copies/phasing/consequence rather than high VAF or two tissue events.
Measured splice junction, antibody epitope/protein fragments/intact protein and fit-for-purpose repair function are distinct layers.
Scars and composite assay/trial cutoffs report history, not a universal present-function clock; reversion can restore function without deleting old damage. Verify longitudinal scope.

Waks8 selected resistant metastatic BRCA-mutant breast cancers:4 acquired reversions plus2 other restoration routes; verify raw paper. RAD51 foci need informative damaged cycling cells and controls; low foci with almost no cycles is uninformative.

Catalytic inhibition, trapping, fork obstacle, compound/exposure context and drug response differ. Murai2012 three-drug contrast; Murai2014 roughly100-fold talazoparib trapping is assay-specific, not a clinical ranking.

Five claims: real DNA, neither parental useful contribution, compatible history, current impairment, clinical benefit. Four confidence checks: coherence, reports, independent reproduction, clinical validation; not score/vote tiers.
Fictional same-scar models: engagement in both, HR impaired versus partly restored and different survival; matched repair restoration could test causality. Clinical applicability still separate.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Define disease, biomarker, setting, intervention, comparator and outcome. Adjuvant recurrence reduction differs from measurable metastatic shrinkage.
Exact assay, germline/somatic, gene/classification, prior treatment and subgroup size remain attached; single arm and cross-trial contrasts do not isolate comparative effect.
SHIVA limits one tested refractory-advanced molecular matching strategy, not every precision treatment.
OlympiA randomized high-risk early gBRCA1/2 versus placebo after initial therapy does not establish somatic-only adjuvant benefit. Verify current/scoped FDA label criteria.

TBCRC0482020 N54: confirmed responses only gPALB2 82% and sBRCA1/2 50%, none ATM/CHEK2 alone; 2026 expansion N54/7TNBC:gPALB2 75%, sBRCA11/30=36.7% missed prespecified target. No adjuvant extrapolation.
Fictional early somatic repair finding+scar+model+metastatic adjacent signal yields hypothesis and unmet direct adjuvant question, not approval or proven benefit.

Approved indication, off-label, trial eligibility/site availability and regulated expanded access are separate; sponsor supply/cooperation and clinical/regulatory/review requirements do not establish appropriateness or efficacy.
Ledger retains unknowns rather than proving benefit or failure; practice metastatic A versus early C with related biomarker cannot become label-supported adjuvant use.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Catalytic PAR signalling inhibition differs from stabilised protein-DNA trap and replication-fork obstacles; repair, creating obstacle and clearing cargo are different steps.
Murai2012 and2014 assay contrasts, talazoparib label and EMBRACA N431/PFS8.6vs5.6/HR0.54 need primary verification and exact qualifying variant scope.
Figure four panels are conceptual; inspect light/dark whole with caption.
Hoslett2026 TEX264/p97 selective trapped-PARP1 nucleophagy is a preclinical cargo/clearance hypothesis, not broad HCQ/CQ equivalence or expression-score resistance prediction.

Fictional more death with lysosomal+PARP drug admits impaired cargo clearance, single-agent toxicity and another stress route; need chromatin-bound PARP, matched controls and independent causal perturbation.
A p97 perturbation affects other jobs; do not call it clearance-specific without controls/rescue. Narrow the guide phrase that current repair function alone decides vulnerability.
Practice asks trapped PARP with/without HCQ plus clearance machinery perturbation; survival alone does not identify mechanism or a treatment indication.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Amount, completed degradative flux and conditional survival dependence are three claims. LC3-II accumulation can mean more formation or less clearance; p62 also changes with production. Bulk RNA is not cargo traffic.

Short verified lysosomal-block comparison and complementary acid-sensitive tandem reporter need adequate controls; little LC3-II change allows low formation or already blocked clearance. Avoid declaring a single assay sufficient.
Fictional hour: A20+30-30=20; B20+5-0=25. Equal initial queue does not give equal flow, and neither establishes survival causality.

Proteasome individual tagged proteins versus lysosomal bulk/organelles is a useful simplified contrast, with p62 linking routes; verify approvals separately from broad lysosomal effects. APEX6.2vs3.5months; pancreaticHCQ112/12-monthOS41vs49 need raw scope.

Bellare2021 talazoparib sensitisation in HR-proficient models with genetic/chloroquine perturbation versus Arun2015 ATG5 reduction partly reducing olaparib apoptosis in BRCA2-mutant HCC1428; model is ER-positive, not TNBC. Read Bellare2025 correction and retained-result scope.

Process perturbation can increase death, reduce drug-induced death or change flux without survival change. Independent perturbation, restoration, timing before death, cell/death rather than metabolic signal, and actual exposure/environment remain necessary.
Try-it lower metabolic signal plus static LC3-II does not prove protective autophagy, death or intended-process causality. Explain-it-back repeats amount/flow/dependence and is not extra credit.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: PI3K lipid signal, AKT, mTORC1 integrating growth/nutrients and PTEN lipid-phosphatase brake; phosphorylation meaning is site- and time-specific rather than abundance, expression or whole-network activity.

Ibrahim PI3K inhibition lowered BRCA1/2 expression and sensitised some BRCA-proficient TNBC models; Kim mTORC1 restrains ULK1 initiation. Initiation is not completed flux, survival effect or uniform repair impairment across cells and compounds.

AKT phosphorylates TSC2, relieves TSC restraint of RHEB; mTORC1-S6K1 suppresses IRS1 and rapalog can release upstream feedback. Verify study scope in cancer cells and patient samples; not inevitable in every tumour.

mTORC2 AKT Ser473 input differs from mTORC1 output. Rapalog, PI3K/AKT drug and ATP-site mTOR inhibitor have different mechanisms and feedback. Named markers S6/4EBP1/AKT sites are not total pathway gauges.
Energy stress AMPK-raptor-mTORC1 restraint can conserve resources; slower growth can coexist with stress survival. AMPK activation alone is not a death readout.

Fictional RNA down, mTORC1 output phosphorylation down, AKT phosphorylation up need not conflict: separate layers, feedback plausible, no net survival conclusion. Need repair, flux, death/regrowth and mechanistic controls.

Pathway drawing cannot establish paired-loss synthetic lethality or net combination benefit; already-deficient repair may not reproduce induced deficiency, and compound, dose, timing and cell state remain attached.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Name cells, outcome, concentration and time. Vehicle, each single drug and combination isolate contrasts; positive control, replicates, dose/time matrix and human exposure comparison answer additional questions.

Fictional remaining viability70%,80%: HSA70%; Bliss0.7*0.8=56%; combination56 matchesBliss but exceedsHSA,30 exceedsboth,65 exceedsHSA only. Loewe needs adequate single-drug dose-response; reference models quantify interaction, not mechanism.

ATP/metabolic signal and single-cell mass accumulation differ from irreversible death. Add direct identity/composition, apoptosis or other death and washout/regrowth of survivors; mixture and culture selection can alter results.
Match flux, chromatin PARP trapping, adequate RAD51 foci and specific genetic perturbation/rescue to the proposed mechanism; drug effects remain to be tested separately.

Response in specified culture, causal explanation in that model and clinical utility are different claims. Ladan proof-of-concept tied to assay, chemotherapy and neoadjuvant setting cannot validate postoperative combinations, human metabolism or organ toxicity.

Living culture needs viable handled specimen; fixation, ordinary snap-freezing and validated viable cryopreservation preserve different properties. Adequacy failures yield no result, not forced biology. Figure nonmalignant cells are a sampled population, not a validated healthy-cell control.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Rescue specificity limits causal resolution: mevalonate add-back restores multiple branches, cannot identify cholesterol. Partial rescue leaves unresolved contributions and does not itself imply a necessary second factor.

HMGCR makes mevalonate; pathway feeds squalene/cholesterol, FPP and GGPP prenylation branches. Sterol sensing via SCAP-SREBP differs from whole-pathway inhibition; verify feedback and protein-prenylation scope.

Freed-Pastor TP53 mutant MDA-MB231/468 three-dimensional architecture: mutant depletion, statin, broad rescue, branch inhibitors, GGPP partial restoration each narrow one question; architecture is not survival or clinical tumour response.

Fictional lipid-poor versus lipid-rich conditions: same synthesis inhibition and different growth with uptake compensation. Target engagement survives while dependence changes with supply; tumour environment remains separate.

Practice cholesterol/GGPP add-back must match block position: a metabolite cannot be assumed to bypass inhibition of the enzyme consuming it. Genetic control helps, but genetic perturbation is not automatically cleaner or perfectly specific.

readingDepth.depth: complete body, first line to final source item
sourceFirstTeachingNotes: Place causal activation relative to inhibited step and experimentally test bypass; real network branches, feedback and off-target effects limit any universal drug-can-only-work rule. Source water-valve analogy is internally contradictory and should be replaced, not copied.

Stoeck6/66 TNBC: NOTCH1 rearrangements retain gamma-secretase cut dependency while particularNOTCH2 fusion begins beyond cut. ActiveNOTCH1 and GSI response in specified lines/mice do not establish clinical selection.
Jiang39 pancreatic lines: all responding lines carried inactivatingRNF43, not allRNF43 variants guarantee dependence. APC/CTNNB1 downstream activation and Morin scope require direct evidence.
RodonWNT974 N94 AXIN2 fell94%pairedskin/74%pairedtumour but noobjective responses; exact biopsydenominators and assessmenttiming needed. Target gene decline is not tumour shrinkage.
FIGHT202 pemigatinib38/107=35.5% FGFR2fusion/rearrangementcholangiocarcinoma; not allRTKfusions identical and partner-induced dimerisation not universalmechanism withoutsource.

Fictional variant versus normal matchedtotalprotein,noextra phosphorylation means noactivation support underthatcondition, not benigninallsettings. Sender/receiver tissueidentity, proximalactiveform/downstreamreadout, drugengagement, causalneed and normal-tissueon-targettoxicity remain distinct.
PracticeCTNNB1phosphosite mutation suggests ligand-independentcanonicalsignal, not guaranteed noantitumoureffect. RNF43loss is mechanismcontext, not a proven drugindication.

Check each signalling phosphorylation site and feedback perturbation at source depth; no named pathway activity inferred from a lone marker.
